description: Fit 2, 4 or 9 PDF pages onto each sheet — save paper when printing slides, drafts and handouts.

faqs.a: 2-up stacks 2 pages vertically, 4-up is a 2×2 grid, 9-up is a 3×3 grid — all on portrait sheets the size of your source pages.
